AboutPage.title: About AutoMac Montreal
AboutPage.subtitle: Your trusted partner for quality vehicles and exceptional automotive services in the heart of Montreal.
AboutPage.storyP1: Founded with a passion for cars and a commitment to our community, AutoMac Montreal has grown from a small local shop to a respected name in the Montreal automotive scene. For years, we've been dedicated to providing high-quality used vehicles and reliable auto repair services.
AboutPage.storyP2: Our journey is built on trust, transparency, and a genuine desire to help our customers find the perfect vehicle or get the best care for their current one. We believe in building long-lasting relationships, one satisfied customer at a time.
AboutPage.value1Desc: We prioritize your needs and satisfaction above all else, ensuring a personalized and positive experience.
AboutPage.value2Desc: We stand by the quality of our vehicles and services, operating with honesty and transparency in all our dealings.
AboutPage.value3Desc: As a local Montreal business, we are committed to serving and supporting our community through reliable automotive solutions.
AboutPage.commitmentDesc: At AutoMac Montreal, our philosophy is simple: provide reliable vehicles, expert service, and an unparalleled customer experience. We understand that buying a car or getting it serviced can be a significant decision, and our team is here to guide you every step of the way with clear communication and professional advice. We're not just selling cars; we're building trust and ensuring your safety and satisfaction on the road.

PrivacyPage.metaDescription: Read the Privacy Policy for AutoMac Montreal to understand how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.
PrivacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPage.intro: Auto Mac ("we", "us", or "our") respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, and safeguard your data in accordance with the privacy laws of Quebec and Canada.
PrivacyPage.section1Intro: We may collect the following personal information when you contact us, visit our location, or use our services:
PrivacyPage.section1Point1: Personal identification information (e.g., your name, phone number, email address)
PrivacyPage.section1Point2: Vehicle information (e.g., make, model, year, license plate)
PrivacyPage.section1Point3: Service request details (e.g., appointment date, type of service)
PrivacyPage.section1Point4: Payment information (if applicable for service transactions)
PrivacyPage.section2Intro: We use the information you provide to:
PrivacyPage.section2Point2: Provide car sales and vehicle-related services such as oil changes, tire services, diagnostics, brake repairs, and general maintenance
PrivacyPage.section2Point3: Communicate with you about your appointment or inquiry
PrivacyPage.section2Point4: Send service updates or promotional messages (only if you have opted in)
PrivacyPage.section2Point5: Comply with legal and regulatory requirements
PrivacyPage.section3Intro: We do not sell or rent your personal information. We may share your data only with:
PrivacyPage.section3Point1: Technicians or staff responsible for providing the services you request
PrivacyPage.section3Point2: Third-party service providers involved in secure payment processing
PrivacyPage.section3Point3: Regulatory authorities if required by law or legal proceedings
PrivacyPage.section3Outro: All parties we share data with are required to protect it in accordance with legal standards.
PrivacyPage.section4Point1: We store your personal information securely and use reasonable measures to protect it from unauthorized access, loss, or misuse.
PrivacyPage.section4Point2: We retain personal data only as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes listed above or to meet legal obligations.
PrivacyPage.section5Point1: Access the personal information we hold about you
PrivacyPage.section5Point2: Request corrections to any inaccurate data
PrivacyPage.section5Point3: Withdraw your consent for future use (where applicable)
PrivacyPage.section5Point4: Request the deletion of your personal data, subject to applicable laws
PrivacyPage.section5Outro: To exercise your rights, contact us using the information below.
PrivacyPage.section6Intro: For questions about this Privacy Policy or to make a privacy-related request, please contact:
